en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Hassan, from Safwan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘There should be no copulation with a (slave) girl until she comes to be of nine or ten years of age’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Hassan from Safwan from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not go to bed with a (underage) girl before she becomes nine or ten years old.’”
